* $A_i$: the set of colorings where vertex $i$ has only $1$ red edge and $3$ blue edges.
* $B_i$: the set of colorings where vertex $i$ has only $3$ red edges and $1$ blue edge.

We can then count the number of valid colorings as follows:

$$\text{Number of valid colorings} = \binom{4}{2}^4 - \sum_{i=1}^4 |A_i| + \sum_{i=1}^4 |B_i|$$
